write_file: {'content': 'import os
from requests.utils import get_netrc_auth
import tempfile

def test_netrc_cases():
    cases = [
        ("machine example.com\n", "Empty entry", None),
        ("machine example.com login pass\n", "Full entry", ("login", "pass")),
        ("machine example.com login\n", "Login only", ("login", "")),
        ("machine example.com : pass\n", "Password only", ("", "pass")),
        ("machine example.com login account pass\n", "Login account pass", ("login", "pass")),
        ("machine example.com  account pass\n", "Account pass", ("account", "pass")),
    ]

    for content, name, expected in cases:
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode='w', delete=False) as tmp:
            tmp.write(content)
            tmp_path = tmp.name

        os.environ["NETRC"] = tmp_path
        try:
            auth = get_netrc_auth("http://example.com")
            print(f"{name}: expected {expected!r}, got {auth!r}")
            assert auth == expected, f"{name}: expected {expected!r}, got {auth!r}"
        finally:
            os.remove(tmp_path)
            del os.environ["NETRC"]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        test_netrc_cases()
        print("All tests passed!")
    except AssertionError as e:
        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
